d: Manchester United are in a mess, and now it's playing out in public. That 4-1 humiliation against Como in the UEFA Champions League made it seven without a win, but the real story was after the game. Bruno Fernandes questioned why Michael Carrick didn't press Como harder, Carrick hit back about the lack of intensity and work rate. Add Lisandro Martinez questioning the recruitment, and United struggling in the Premier League and Champions League, and this feels bigger than one bad night. Is Bruno just speaking up because he cares, or is the captain making a bad situation worse? Rupha Ramani…
